identity.name: Presage Sharp Edged Series GMT
identity.one_liner: The Presage Sharp Edged GMT — angular case lines, asymmetric dial pattern, 6R64 flyable GMT movement.

provenance_events.description: Seiko adds a GMT to the Presage Sharp Edged family — a 42.2mm steel case, asymmetric dial, 6R64 flyable GMT movement.

narrative.story: The Presage Sharp Edged line is Seiko's more angular dress line — narrower lugs, more aggressive case bevels, and a dial pattern inspired by traditional Japanese textile. The SARY200 adds a true GMT on the 6R64 movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The sapphire bezel insert is a step up from the standard Presage aluminium insert. The 6R64 is a 70-hour reserve movement with a flyable GMT.
